subject: Borealis executive day — site evacuation, propose hybrid shift
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@borealisbank.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, facilities@borealisbank.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Building evacuation at Borealis HQ — impact to tomorrow's exec day

Hi Aditya —

I’m really sorry to flag this last minute. We had a major sprinkler activation in the lobby overnight (apparently a malfunction in the main riser), Facilities has evacuated the building and the fire marshal won’t sign off until the clean-up and ceiling repairs are complete. They’re estimating at least 24–48 hours to make the space safe and clear.

That means we can’t use the boardroom or any of the conference suites tomorrow (Oct 20) for the on-site executive day. I know a lot of people are traveling in — my apologies for the disruption.

Options we can offer from our side:
- Move to a fully virtual half-day (morning exec brief + afternoon breakouts online) and aim to reschedule the in-person portion for two weeks out (Nov 3) — we can confirm rooms once Facilities has a definitive timeline.
- Try to source an offsite venue nearby (we're checking partner hotels, but availability is uncertain on short notice).

Can you let me know whether Redwood prefers to pivot to hybrid/virtual or postpone the whole day? We’ll do what we can to accommodate.

Attaching a quick photo of the lobby damage and the Facilities incident number.

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Grant
Head of Executive Events, Borealis Bank
olivia.grant@borealisbank.com
[Attachment: facility_incident_photo.jpg (image/jpeg)]

From: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, dev.patel@redwoodinference.com, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: URGENT: Building evacuation at Borealis HQ — impact to tomorrow's exec day

Folks —

Received the note below from Olivia. Short timeline and some heavy constraints on their side. Quick thoughts:
- If we can run a high-touch virtual morning (exec briefing + prioritized Q&A) we preserve the most important customer time and avoid canceling flights for senior execs.
- For the onsite portion, suggest we propose Nov 3 as a tentative in-person date (2 weeks out) — gives Facilities time + gives our team runway to rebook travel if needed.
- Marissa: can you check AV/virtual runbook and whether we can deliver the hands-on demo remotely? Jasmine: can you draft a 90-min remote agenda that maps to the original onsite goals? Dev: status on flights/hotel for our team? Which folks are already en route?

I’ll reply to Olivia to propose the hybrid fallback and request firm attendee list for the virtual session.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

From: dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: URGENT: Building evacuation at Borealis HQ — impact to tomorrow's exec day

Short update on travel:
- Myself and two engineers are still in transit — our flight into BOS has been delayed 6+ hours due to an ATC staffing issue affecting the region; Delta just rebooked everyone but earliest we land is late evening.
- Hotel bookings are refundable without penalty (confirmed).
- Marcus and Priya opted to fly red-eye last night and are on site already — they can support virtual moderation if needed.

I’ll pull a quick CSV of affected reservations and forward to Ops so we can cancel/rebook cleanly (attached). If we flip to virtual for the morning, we should be OK — but the hands-on lab with GPUs will be rough.

[Attachment: cancelled_flight_list.csv]

—Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@borealisbank.com>, Borealis Facilities <facilities@borealisbank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, dev.patel@redwoodinference.com, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: URGENT: Building evacuation at Borealis HQ — impact to tomorrow's exec day

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up and for the photo — sorry to hear about the mess. We want to be as flexible as possible. Proposed plan from Redwood:

1) Pivot to a hybrid program for tomorrow (Oct 20):
   - 09:00–12:00 ET: Executive briefing (virtual) — Redwood will produce a condensed 90-minute presentation + 30-minute moderated Q&A.
   - 13:00–16:00 ET: Breakouts and product deep dives — virtual only for teams who can’t get to site; we’ll keep open the option for any on-site folks if Facilities secures a rooms update.

2) Tentatively reschedule full in-person workshop to Tue Nov 3 (we can confirm when Borealis Facilities gives the all-clear). If Nov 3 works for you, we’ll hold space and start rebooking travel; otherwise suggest Nov 10 as alternate.

Action items:
- Olivia: please confirm whether the executive sponsors can join virtually tomorrow morning and whether Nov 3 is a workable tentative date.
- Marissa: I’ve asked you to update the remote runbook and AV checklist — can you have a short run-through with Marcus and Priya this evening?
- Dev: please send the final cancelled flight CSV to Ops and hold on rebookings until we freeze the new onsite date.

Attaching an updated, shortened agenda for the virtual session (updated_agenda_v2.pdf) and the venue floorplan so we can reassign breakout rooms if Facilities updates availability.

We’ll also prepare a one-slide summary we can send to the execs this afternoon to set expectations.

Best,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: updated_agenda_v2.pdf]

From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@borealisbank.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Borealis Facilities <facilities@borealisbank.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, dev.patel@redwoodinference.com, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: URGENT: Building evacuation at Borealis HQ — impact to tomorrow's exec day

Aditya — thanks, that plan sounds good and appreciated. Confirmations:
- Exec sponsors (CIO and Head of Platform) can join the 09:00–12:00 ET virtual window.
- Nov 3 is likely to work for the in-person make-up; Facilities has penciled us in but will confirm by end of week once the contractor estimates are firm.
- If Facilities gets one of the on-site suites cleared by tomorrow afternoon, we’ll let you know and we can mix a very small in-person group with remote.

I’m attaching the Facilities incident report overview and a quickly-signed addendum to the room reservation that reflects the emergency closure.

Appreciate the quick turn. We’ll update attendee list for the virtual session by 17:00 ET today.

Olivia
[Attachment: facility_incident_report.pdf, venue_floorplan.png]
